releases.notes:
Updated to 7.3_04 and to Halplibe 5.3.0!

- No longer requires TerrainAPI or Dragonfly, models have been remade in code and generation done with mixin
- Swamps have gotten an overhaul with big dripleafs and vines
- Permafrost copper ore has been added
- Lightning rod should work much better as a conductor now
- Axolotls are currently unfinished
- Some textures have been cleaned up/tweaked


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LukeisStuff/caves-and-cliffs-bta/compare/1.0.1...2.0

mods.name: Caves and Cliffs
mods.description: Remaking the 1.17 and 1.18 release updates of minecraft in BTA!

releases.notes:
- Increased starting Block ID to fix conflict with Bonus Blocks
- Changed many textures

BTA - 7.2_01
Halplibe - 4.1.3
TerrainAPI - 1.4.4-7.2-pre1
Dragonfly - 1.6.0-7.2-0.1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LukeisStuff/caves-and-cliffs-bta/compare/1.0...1.0.1

BTA - 7.2_01
Halplibe - 4.1.3
TerrainAPI -**Blocks -**
- Amethyst, Budding Amethyst and Amethyst Clusters, found in geodes
- Copper Ore, found underground commonly
- Copper Blocks and Copper Bricks, with stairs/slabs, All of them oxidize in water, use an axe to scrape it off
- Powder Snow, Found in glacier biomes 
- Candles and Colored Candles
- Dripstone
- Azalea tree set, Logs, Leaves, Saplings
- Moss and Moss Layer
- Rooted Dirt and Roots
- Raw Ore Blocks
- Glow Berry Vines, found in swamps
- Lichen
- Dripleaf, and Spore plants
- Tuff, found in geodes
- Calcite, found in geodes
- Lightning Rod (WIP)

**Items -**
- Raw Copper and Copper Ingot
- Amethyst Shard
- Glow Berries, heals 1 heart in 4 ticks, stacks to 6
- Goat Horn, Can play multiple different songs
- Glowing Inc Sac, crafts into cyan dye or used to craft lichen
- Otherside Disc, try to find it!

**Entities -**
- Goats, kill them to collect horns
- Axolotls, tame them and have a watery pet
- Glow Squid, found at night, drops glowing ink sacs

**Generation -** 
- Geodes, generate underground in multiple sizes
- Many new blocks generate all over the world
- Azalea Trees
- Swamp trees grow vines 1.4.4-7.2-pre1
Dragonfly - 1.6.0-7.2-0.1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/LukeisStuff/caves-and-cliffs-bta/commits/1.0
